summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine monthly traffic statistics for July 2026. The release states guest numbers grew 7% year-over-year to a record 22.2 million, with load factor steady at 96%, and approximately 120,800 flights operated. Rolling 12-month guests rose 5% to 213.2 million. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any risk-arb or event-driven analysis.
